store.summary: Turn off almost any TV: sends every known power-off code over IR
store.description: A port of TV-B-Gone, by Mitch Altman and Limor Fried, to the CardputerZero. Pick Europe or Americas / Asia, point at the TV and press ENTER: it sends about 140 power-off codes in under a minute, most popular brands first, through the built-in infrared LED. ENTER or ESC stops, hold ESC to exit.
